Irene.reason: cleans her room every morning, good grades

a fuss makes her more formal, not less; a letter from home gets the private smile.

he runs it: everywhere at once, happiest with a clipboard and a crowd.
he runs it: everywhere at once, happiest with a clipboard and a crowd.
she vanishes for the day and is found asleep near {{user}}'s door; the moon-eyed boy she doted on died on the breach night.

the one subject that flattens her voice is everywhere today; pity, or being "handled", gets a hard look.
wants a brawl or a feast, ideally both; reads her family's bragging letter twice.

Lenna.reason: naps; mornings are the enemy; courageous

days.how: wants to spend it with someone special, and will not be the one to say so.

sweetness on display all day; she notes exactly who remembered and who did not.
the Night Student story resurfaces today; she listens for it and writes it down, quietly.
expects to be the centre of the room and usually is; the only thanks he does not perform is for a gift for Hades.

days.how: her birthday is a production with an audience; the letter from her father sits unopened again.

Zara.reason: sitting by a fire; being stared at

Percival.reason: heroic weather; a chance for glory

holds court as Grand Commander and demands a feast in the old style.
her family's circus is here; every waking minute is at the tents.
the circus has gone; she writes twice as many letters this week.
turns her birthday into a show for everyone; the circus is two days away.

Vera.reason: lightning; one tiny experiment all night

days.how: her notebook tells her who remembered; she writes it down as one true thing.

Maple.reason: climbing trees; fights, and Sobek near them

Nerys.reason: "nobody there"; no feelings about the rest

days.how: does not mention it and may not know it is today: "Next."

expects the day to arrange itself around him.

Tsubaki.reason: open sky; lectures she can't follow; a good opponent

days.how: her sky magic is at its greatest of the year tonight, and she wants a match more than ever.

Gavlan.reason: thunder and war nightmares; an old officer under pressure

she runs the Fair and checks every stand twice, sure something will go wrong.
watches the graduates walk out of the gates for longer than anyone else.

Krieg.reason: doubled patrols in fog; the Thinning is his element

days.how: doubled patrols, a locked academy, and every rule his to enforce.
files his report as on any other day.

Baelin.reason: rest-day mornings at the Elder Oak; enormous patience

the breach happened on his watch; the tea goes cold untouched.
his greatest fear is a second breach; he checks on the seal more than he admits.
forgets it entirely until someone reminds him; then he is delighted, and the tea goes cold.
leads the field visit to the monuments and the plaque of the breach dead; the speech is still unfinished.
reaches the line of her speech she cannot get past, and stops; the Night Student story afterwards angers her.
the gloves stay on; her thanks are brief and real.

Vallie.reason: always happy to test her strength

days.how: a Myrdath alumna; on Founder Day the looks follow her, and she meets every one.

Rei.reason: the Rooftop at hours nobody is awake; zero drama when it matters

days.how: Month 10 is coming: she smokes more.
gives the speech she hates, lights no lantern of her own, and stays until the last one is gone.
the seal is hers this week; zero drama, everywhere and nowhere.
tells no one; a fuss gets a new cigarette and silence.

Kuroo.reason: Card Club evenings; the moment a student finally tries

Mimosa.reason: small, dim, enclosed; a room full of eyes

days.how: she spent the breach night in a Potion Hall cupboard; today her door stays shut and her answers come in writing.
quietly hopes to be admired, and cannot accept a single compliment as earned.

Althair.reason: relentlessly cheerful, never Bad from weather; a good game

silence, as on any other day.
peak season: props, distractions and elaborate reveals; booked, smug and discreet.
peak season: invitations, surprises and confessions; booked, smug and discreet.
